candidate_generation.retained: old input pose + best4 official candidates by input-only normalized score, <=5 total/keyframe
candidate_generation.fallback_only_if_megapose_unavailable: old pose times canonical longest principal-axis rotations [0,90,180,270] degrees and camera-ray translation factors [.9,1,1.1]; 12 finite starts, no reference offset
candidate_generation.paths: historical whole path plus two diverse input-score beam paths. Interpolate keyframe corrections over old input motion using actual times, preserve endpoints.

fixed_geometry.canonical_origin: historical arithmetic mean of all scan vertices
fixed_geometry.shape: exact old canonical vertices/faces; all points share R/t; no appearance/scale/camera/human/background updates

input_terms.block_normalization: Each per-frame block divided by sqrt(sample count). Robust soft_l1, f_scale=1. Missing block zero, counts kept. No reference residual.
input_terms.silhouette: observed object pixels to projected mesh surface samples (chair) or convex-hull outside distance (closed box); projected samples/boundary to background distance; human/unknown not negative; no partial bbox size equality
input_terms.depth_validity: historical depth_observed_mask plus finite values, >.1m and robust median +- max(.2m,4*1.4826*MAD), frozen rule
input_terms.rgb: fixed 9x9 patch RGB/NCC gate plus cross-source overlap descriptor test; separate score/count; no learned appearance

correspondence.source_attachment: candidate frontmost ray-triangle hit tied to each candidate path; NEVER treated as independent confirmation
correspondence.cross_source_confirmation: two different seed frames with >=2 shared reliable target observations within 2.5px, source patch NCC>=.5 and RGB mean absolute difference<=35/255, candidate canonical separation<=.025m; both remain conditional on path; no claim of true material labels
correspondence.unconfirmed: record candidate/uncertain, exclude strong fixed canonical track residual; missing visibility dormant, no added observation

optimization.algorithm: scipy least_squares sparse whole-trajectory SE3, robust soft_l1

path_selection.input_score: mean robust normalized silhouette + depth + confirmed-track + acceleration + 0.1*RGB cross-source inconsistency; includes visibility coverage counts and 0.1*(1-confirmed/input-reliable coverage) to avoid zero-track preference
path_selection.iou: same old/new actual triangle union; predicted object ignored at human or unknown pixels; fixed masks, no frame dropping
hard_rejections: any referenced surface vertex behind camera

S1_star.interpretation: initial pose + soft-prior target + correction temporal reference change together

deadline: bounded 2-3 days; no new search grid
